SEVERITY: major
WHERE: .github/workflows/ci.yml:~264
ISSUE: `artifact-name: monartha-sbom-${{ matrix.platform }}.spdx.json` references an undefined matrix var (`matrix.platform`; the job matrices on `os`), so every platform job uploads the identical artifact name `monartha-sbom-.spdx.json`, and duplicate artifact names in one workflow run make later uploads fail.
FIX: Use `${{ matrix.os }}` so each platform gets a unique SBOM artifact.

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: scripts/check-versions.mjs:22
ISSUE: The Cargo.toml regex `/^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/m` matches the first `version =` line anywhere in the file, not only the `[package]` section, so a dependency version declared before the package version would be compared.
FIX: Anchor the match to the `[package]` section (e.g. parse TOML or match only after `\[package\]`).

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: scripts/check-versions.mjs:14-30
ISSUE: `readFileSync` and `JSON.parse` can throw uncaught exceptions (missing file, malformed JSON/TOML), emitting raw stack traces instead of a clean gate failure.
FIX: Wrap reads/parsing in try/catch and route failures through `fail()`.

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: scripts/check-versions.mjs (new file)
ISSUE: The new CI gate script has no automated test; behavior is only verified manually per docs.
FIX: Add a small test covering match, mismatch, and missing/malformed-file cases.

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: .github/workflows/ci.yml:~259
ISSUE: `anchore/sbom-action` scans `path: ./`, pulling in `node_modules/`, `target/`, and `.venv/` — producing a bloated SBOM of dev/build dependencies not shipped in the release.
FIX: Scope `path:` to release-relevant files or exclude `node_modules`, `target`, `.venv`.

VERDICT: FIX
